newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 13.

text.p: -- Conrail Inc and CSX Corp are expected to reaffirm their $8.5 billion merger deal despite a rival $10 billion bid from Norfolk Southern Corp, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing sources.
Conrail closed at 97-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange on Tuesday. CSX closed at 44-5/8 and Norfolk finished at 87-3/4.
-- Westinghouse Electric Corp is expected to announce plans to split into two companies, separating its manufacturing and broadcasting operations. Shares closed at 20-5/8.

-- Dell Computer posted third quarter earnings of $1.52 a share after the market close on Tuesday, well above Wall Street estimates of $1.16 a share. Before a charge, Dell earned $1.56 a share, more than double its year-ago earnings of $0.75. It also set a two-for-one stock split. Dell shares closed at 88-5/8 on the Nasdaq. They rose 1-7/8 to 90-1/2 in after-hours trading.
-- Campbell Soup Co, Federated Department Stores Inc, Gymboree Corp and Lowe's Cos Inc are scheduled to release quarterly results today.

-- ICF Kaiser said it believes it can still meet 1996 earnings estimates despite disappointing third-quarter results. After the market closed, it reported earnings of $0.01 a share for the third quarter, down from $0.05 a year ago. Shares closed at 1-7/8 on the NYSE.
